# Independent hardware regression fixtures

These small circuits were written for native migration verification in 2026.
They are not student exercise replacements. The differential harness copies
them into disposable Java/native directories and compares every generated byte.
Each engine loads the supplied built-ins through its own normal lookup path.
No expected comparison file is overwritten or generated from native output.

The project 1–3 scripts in the harness are separately copied from the uploaded
baseline and exercised against bundled built-in declarations, without copying
or replacing the unfinished student HDL files.
